implementationMap.component: Stop signal creation and detection (S1, S2)
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Abort fires on either a disk stop intent or a registered aborted launch signal; error is named WorkflowStopRequested with message 'workflow stop requested for <runId>'.

S2 error name and message format

implementationMap.observedBehavior: bindWorkflowLaunchSignal returns an unbind closure that removes the signal and deletes the map entry when the last signal is removed.
Default poll is 200ms, not the spec's 50ms; minimum clamp is 1ms, not the spec's 10ms.

implementationMap.evidence: .catch(() => undefined,) in check path; readWorkflowStopIntent(cwd, runId) without catch in throwIfWorkflowStopRequested
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Watch path treats read errors as no stop; throwIfWorkflowStopRequested propagates read errors to the caller.
relatedSignals: S4 watch path swallows read errors

implementationMap.evidence: const timer = setInterval(() => void check(), pollMs); ... dispose: () => clearInterval(timer),
implementationMap.observedBehavior: dispose clears the interval so no new periodic reads start; the initial check() call is not gated by a disposed flag.
Classifier also accepts errors identified only by message prefix, contrary to the spec's name-only rule.

implementationMap.evidence: candidate === "cancelled" || candidate === "timeout"; value.cancelled === true; details?.cancelled === true
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Accepts 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as reason strings and cancelled boolean flags beyond the spec's three exact strings aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR.
relatedSignals: C1 extra strings cancelled and timeout

implementationMap.evidence: const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(entry.text); if (parsed !== value && isWorkflowReturnedCancellation(parsed)) return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Parses text entries in content arrays and recurses on the parsed value; the parsed !== value guard can never be true for freshly parsed JSON, and recursion depth is bounded by nesting in the string.
relatedSignals: C2 recursion on parsed JSON content
parsed !== value guard is effectively dead

implementationMap.component: Terminal semantic status for non-dynamic runs (T1)
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Completed runs with degradation map to completed_degraded; this path is overwritten for direct-dynamic runs.

implementationMap.component: Dynamic controller control.json read and semantic status (T2)
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Unreadable or missing control.json yields undefined, so the else branch sets completed_without_semantic_result; a dynamic_incomplete task sets dynamic_incomplete first.
relatedSignals: T2 unreadable control maps to completed_without_semantic_result

implementationMap.evidence: outputRetryAttempts: run.tasks.reduce(...); launchRetries: run.tasks.reduce((total, task) => total + (task.launchRetry?.attempts ?? 0), 0,
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Output retries are summed as outputRetryAttempts, but launch retries are exposed as launchRetries, not the public-contract name launchRetryAttempts.
